newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU to see how media can help Bosnia peace.
newsitem.headline: EU to see how media can help Bosnia peace.

text.p: The European Commission said on Wednesday it would host a conference at the end of the month to discuss the role of the media in fostering peace in former Yugoslavia.
It said the conference, to be held in Brussels on Nov 29, was also being supported by the Council of Europe, the European Parliament and the International Federation of Journalists (IFJ).
Among those giving key-note speeches, the Commission said in a statement, would be Theo Sommer, editor of Germany's Die Zeit, and IFJ Secretary-General Aidan White.
Journalists from Croatia, Bosnia-Herzegovina and the Former Yugoslav Republic of Macedonia would attend, the Commission said.
"It will focus on the media situation in the countries which are signatories of the (Bosnia) peace agreement," it said.
"The media's crucial role on the democratic reconstruction and fostering of stability in the region will be one of the topics of discussion," it said.
